name: Stained Glass Suncatcher With Crystal Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:

Crafted from high-quality acrylic with a glass-like appearance, paired with dazzling crystal charms. The material is durable, weather-resistant, and ideal for both indoor and outdoor display.

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

Available in four round panel sizes:

 - 10 x 10 cm ~ 3.94 x 3.94 inches

 - 15 x 15 cm ~ 5.9 x 5.9 inches

 - 20 x 20 cm ~ 7.87 x 7.87 inches

 - 25 x 25 cm ~ 9.84 x 9.84 inches

Panel Thickness: 5 mm

 Crystal Charms:

 - Round Crystal Charm: 8 cm ~ 3.15 in height, 3 cm ~ 1.18 in diameter

 - Rainbow Crystal Charm: Rainbow Pendant with Crystal Ball - 12 cm ~ 4.72 in height, 3 cm ~ 1.18 in diameter

  • Printing Technology:

Printed using high-resolution UV printing technology on one side only. The artwork is sharp, vibrant, and long-lasting, maintaining its clarity and color even under direct sunlight.

  • Functional & Usage:

Ideal as a window hanging decoration, this suncatcher casts stunning rainbow reflections when sunlight passes through the crystal charm. It can also be displayed on walls, balconies, gardens, or car windows to brighten up any space.

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions:

A meaningful and beautiful gift for all ages and genders. Perfect for holidays, birthdays, housewarmings, Mother’s Day, Christmas, anniversaries, or any special occasion.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
